tagline: Sync calendar events to Notion and prep meetings automatically
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Notion Integration: Meeting Notes Pages
metaDescription: Get a Notion notes page for every calendar meeting, with context gathered before you join. GAIA keeps a calendar database in Notion too. See the setup steps.
intro: Meeting preparation and notes capture are productivity fundamentals that most professionals do inconsistently. Notion is the ideal home for meeting notes and context, but creating notes pages for each meeting and populating them with attendee and agenda information is tedious enough to skip. GAIA automates the entire pipeline between Google Calendar and Notion, from meeting prep to notes archiving.

useCases.title: Auto-create Notion meeting notes pages
useCases.description: GAIA creates a page for each upcoming meeting, pre-populated with date, time, attendees, agenda from the calendar invite, and sections for notes and action items.

useCases.title: Meeting context compilation
useCases.description: Before each meeting, GAIA researches attendees, pulls related pages from the workspace, and adds context to the meeting notes page so you walk in prepared with relevant background.

useCases.title: Calendar database in Notion
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a database of all your calendar events with properties like attendees, meeting type, and outcome, creating a searchable log of your meetings.

useCases.title: Post-meeting action item capture
useCases.description: After a meeting ends, GAIA prompts you to review the notes page and can extract action items to your task manager of choice, closing the gap between meetings and execution.

useCases.title: Weekly planning from calendar
useCases.description: GAIA reads your upcoming week's calendar and creates a weekly planning page with your schedule, prep notes for each meeting, and time blocked for focused work.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize both accounts and specify which workspace section or database should receive meeting notes.
Choose which calendar event types get pages, what the page template should look like, and which properties map from the event to the page fields.
Meeting notes pages appear automatically before each meeting. You add your notes during and after the meeting, and GAIA handles the administrative setup.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create meeting notes for all calendar events or only selected ones?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to create notes for all events, only events with attendees (excluding solo focus blocks), only events above a certain duration, or based on calendar tags. Full flexibility.

faqs.question: Does GAIA update Notion when a calendar event is rescheduled?
faqs.answer: Yes. When an event time changes, GAIA updates the date and time properties on the corresponding page to stay accurate.

faqs.question: Can multiple team members share the same meeting notes?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create shared meeting notes accessible to all attendees in a shared workspace, ensuring everyone has the same notes page rather than fragmented individual copies.
